verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party pricing documentation explaining whether Netlify charges per seat, sets minimum seat counts, or how cost scales with team size. One community comment mentions Netlify trying to charge per user, and another says pricing was hard to find. Neither is product documentation that lets a buyer know the seat-pricing model, so this applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I know whether pricing is per-seat with minimum seat counts that increase cost as my team grows
